verdict.rationale: Brave's public API page advertises a self-serve credit model: up to $20 in free calls every month and prepaid credits with no subscription. Signup and key issuance take minutes, and community users describe switching to the AI-inference plan themselves, so pricing is reachable without sales. However, the evidence never shows an actual per-request or per-1,000-call rate, so the 'clear per-request pricing' part is unproven. missing for 10: explicit published per-request/per-credit rates, plan-by-plan price breakdown, independent confirmation of pricing clarity.
